fusions.name: Rake Marks
fusions.desc: A raking bite that deals 8 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding half their remaining damage to the blow. It needs one of your afflictions on the target.

fusions.name: Floe Shove
fusions.desc: Pushes a wave across a cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 12 damage to everything in it, knocks them back 3 tiles and leaves them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrum
fusions.desc: A low purr restores 2 health a second to you and every ally for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Toying with the Catch
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
